Uh-uh. No one ''wants'' to be the Amyrlin Seat. Those who do most of the time turn out to be bad choices for it. As far as we've seen, the single most successful Amyrlins were the ones who initially refused and later on only grudgingly accepted the position. Maybe the Hall will view it as a "reward" and even treat Moiraine with respect, but just like Rmmateus already stated, Moiraine would do a Cadsuane and disappear for ten years if someone planned to put her on the Seat.

As for the Amyrlin Seat after Cadsuane, we can only speculate. Lelaine will be in the right category - high-ranking in strength with ''saidar'', at the very least 155 years old and most likely over 200, of the same Hall-aligned axis as the former four true Amyrlin Seats - but I'll be entirely open; I'm not fond of Lelaine.

If there is a woman I'd like to see on the Seat it'd be Saerin Asnobar. Yes. She'd make a decent Amyrlin Seat. She, or Pevara Tazanovni. That'd be a twist, aight?
